title: Data snapshot
notes: Snapshot of real data captured 2026-10-19 17:40 UTC. Run the Python backend for continuously updated data.
Space-weather values are real NOAA SWPC / NASA DONKI data.
GOES electrons at geostationary orbit stand in for the REleASE electron channel until ESA SWE access is configured.
Crew, mission and dosimeter readings are simulated.
Latest proton reading in this data set is from 2026-10-09 14:30 UTC; it is held constant.

safe.label: Safe
safe.summary: All radiation levels are within normal operational limits.
safe.action: No action required. Continue standard operations.

caution.label: Caution Needed
caution.summary: Elevated particle levels detected. Cumulative dose is rising.
caution.action: Monitor dose trend. Prepare for potential exposure mitigation. Limit time in exposed zones.

action.label: Action Needed
action.summary: Radiation exposure threshold exceeded or rapidly approaching.
action.action: Suspend EVA and outdoor activity. Move to shielded area immediately. Log exposure time and notify radiation safety lead.
